meta.title: NewsNow Hot News
meta.description: Reads hot and trending news from a NewsNow deployment (Zhihu, Weibo, Douyin, V2EX, GitHub and more) in a sidebar panel, and exposes the same feed to the agent.

text.title: Hot News
text.subtitle: Live data from a NewsNow deployment
text.empty: This source has no items right now.
text.autoHint: Refresh enabled sources in batches at the chosen interval.
text.sidebarHint: Embedded: open in a split view beside the card wall; Sidebar: open in the right dock; System: hand links to the system browser.
text.addHelp: The id must be a source supported by NewsNow. The full list lives in the server/sources directory of the GitHub repo newsnext/newsnow (for example douban, zaobao). Verify it first by opening https://newsnow.busiyi.world/api/s?id=<id> in a browser; ids the public deployment does not serve will show a load error.
text.manageHint: Toggles apply immediately in this process. To keep them, add the config below to your profile cordis.patch.yml.
text.addIdHint: A NewsNow source id such as zhihu. Lowercase letters, digits and . _ : - only.
text.addHint: For a self-hosted NewsNow, use a source id registered in your deployment.
text.allDisabled: Every source is disabled. Open “Manage sources” to enable at least one.
text.noneAtAll: No sources are available. Open “Manage sources” to add a custom source.
